description: JavaScript source code for the 'Quick Stock Balance' form in ERPNext, defining UI behaviors, form setup, event handlers, and server calls related to stock balance reporting.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, setting query filters for 'item'.

methods.name: make_custom_stock_report_button
methods.description: Creates a custom button to generate the stock balance report.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, disables save, and adds the report button.

methods.name: check_warehouse_and_date
methods.description: Validates if warehouse and date are entered; prompts user if not.

methods.name: warehouse
methods.description: Event triggered when warehouse is changed; fetches stock and item details.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Event triggered when date is changed; fetches stock and item details.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Event triggered when item is changed; updates last updated element and fetches details.

methods.name: item_barcode
methods.description: Event triggered when barcode is changed; updates last updated element and fetches details.

methods.name: get_stock_and_item_details
methods.description: Fetches stock and item details from server based on current form data.
